'''Arebis''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of unknown Ajah.

==History==
She has a [[Warder]], therefore she is not [[Red Ajah]].

==Activities==
She has remained loyal to the [[White Tower]] during the split. 

Arebis, along with [[Desala Nevanche]], [[Melare]], [[Zanica]] and three other Aes Sedai, were involved in [[Leane]]'s capture at [[Tar Valon#Northharbor|Northharbor]]. {{Ref/book|11|p}}
